about: Step 19c: the product atlas, part A: product cards for the step-19 goods and Hyderabad in 1948. Cards with an item and a box are sold by the sellers named, in that box and those years; cards with a good give that good's lot a local name there. Prices are in days of work (the money table turns them into money). Years marked estimate are estimates.

products.name: Newspaper
products.price: by era: a quarter of a day's pay before 1830, a twelfth to 1899, a sixteenth from 1900 (1 anna in Hyderabad in 1948)
products.life: printed papers from 1605 (Strasbourg); India from 1780 (Calcutta); a region's cities first, towns 50 years later (estimate)
products.usedFor: news; its names go into the history book and its places onto a map

products.name: Handwritten newsletter
products.life: Roman Acta copies 59 BCE to about 235; Mughal news-writers from Akbar's time; Venetian avvisi from 1566; Chinese court gazettes from 713
products.usedFor: news for those who can pay

products.name: Map
products.price: half a day's pay printed (8 annas in Hyderabad in 1948), three days' pay drawn by hand
products.life: towns and roads of its year
products.usedFor: finding places; marks from papers; Xaero's map

products.name: Money
products.life: barter before 600 BCE; coins after; the money of each place and year (step 19a)

products.name: Osmania biscuits
products.lore: Biscuits named after the Nizam, eaten with Irani tea.
products.life: a hospital snack in the 1940s, sold in Irani cafés

products.name: Toddy
products.lore: Palm wine, tapped from palm trees each morning and sold at licensed shops.
products.life: tapped by the Goud community; very old (start year estimated)

products.name: Gongadi blanket
products.lore: A blanket of black Deccani sheep wool, woven by Kuruma shepherds. It lasts ten years.

products.name: Singareni coal
products.lore: Coal from the Singareni mines, first worked in 1889.

products.name: Weapons
products.life: see WEAPONS_RESEARCH.md; in India a licence from 1878
